source: Parliamentary Handbook API, records of service (ROSTypeID 11, parliamentary party)
note: Party periods for every senator whose service reaches 2006 or later. `from` to `fetched` is the dated range: Senate divisions inside it are checked against these records. A period runs from start to the day before end; an open period runs to `through` (the end of service, or the fetch date while the senator still sits). A record with neither date is left out; one with only an end runs from the start of service. Built by scripts/build_handbook_parties.py; read by scripts/vote_parties.py.
